definitions.explanation: A person who works in a store, helping customers and handling sales. Can refer to any retail employee.

examples.japanese: {店員|てんいん}に{聞|き}いてください。
{店員|てんいん}さんがとても{親切|しんせつ}でした。
examples.english: The store clerk was very kind.

examples.japanese: {店員|てんいん}として{働|はたら}いています。
examples.english: I work as a store clerk.

notes:
Combines {店|みせ} (store) and {員|いん} (member/staff). Often addressed with さん: {店員|てんいん}さん.

Related words:
- {店長|てんちょう} (store manager)
- {従業員|じゅうぎょういん} (employee).
